integrity_statement: The homotopy statement is proved by a geometric identification at scale one and an explicit exact finite relative elementary-collapse certificate at scale sqrt(2); the inclusion-induced Weyl homology representation is determined by orientation. No later-stage behavior is claimed.
limitations: Only Euclidean scales below sqrt(3) for the unrescaled standard F4 roots are classified. The relative collapse is not a Weyl-equivariant matching. Possible unindexed equivalent literature remains a risk.
title: A persistent \(3\)-sphere in the first Euclidean Rips stages of the \(F_4\) roots
